objective: Calibrate model routing. Test 3 conditions: A=Gemma-only, B=Nemotron-only, C=Gemma+Nemotron ensemble. Only variable is model routing. Frozen engine: search, claims, 102, 103 evidence graph, thresholds, case corpus.

frozen_engine.obviousness_103: V3.9 separated 4-question chain (EVIDENCE_EXISTS / MOTIVATION / COMPATIBILITY / EXPECTATION + whole-claim + combination penalty)

A_GEMMA_ONLY.role: all LLM stages (GENERATOR, NOVELTY, OBVIOUSNESS, ADJUDICATION)

B_NEMOTRON_ONLY.description: Test whether Nemotron alone improves generalization

C_ENSEMBLE.nemotron_role: INDEPENDENT ADVERSARIAL CHALLENGE (separate 103 analysis, not seeded with Gemma's reasoning)
C_ENSEMBLE.adjudicator_role: receives structured evidence from both, NOT model verdicts. Must NOT see 'Gemma says obvious' or 'Nemotron says not obvious'

ensemble_rules.obviousness_risk_accepted: only when structured evidence graph satisfies the same frozen gate
ensemble_rules.model_disagreement: produces MODEL_DISAGREEMENT status, not automatic vote

decision_rule: Choose based on CALIBRATION PERFORMANCE ON FROZEN CORPUS, not parameter count or subjective quality.
stop_rule: No 50->5. No buyer-directed inventions. First establish which model is calibrated.
